summary: Murano Global Investments PLC, a UK parent, filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, disclosing the early settlement of an exchange offer and consent solicitation by Banco Multiva as Issuer Trustee. Eligible holders tendered US$301.99 million of the outstanding 11.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 (approximately 99.67% of the US$303 million outstanding) for new Fixed Rate Senior Secured Notes due 2032. The Issuer Trust received requisite consents, executed a supplemental indenture amending and restating the existing indenture, and settled the exchange early. This is a debt restructuring-like event but not an equity special situation; it involves note exchange mechanics, guarantors, and trustee roles, with no stated price per share or premium. Watch for the final settlement of remaining notes and any impact on Murano's consolidated debt profile.
